title: About AZAFCO International
subtitle: Egypt's Leading Fish Exporter Since 2008
story: AZAFCO International was founded in 2008 in Kafr El Sheikh, Egypt. From a single vision, we've grown to become a trusted source for premium fresh fish worldwide, exporting +2,500 tons monthly via air and land.
vision: To be the world's trusted partner for Egyptian fresh fish export
mission: Delivering ISO & HACCP certified fresh fish to distributors, restaurants, and hotels worldwide
company_description: AZAFCO International is Egypt's leading B2B fish exporter, serving distributors, restaurants, and hotels across +9 countries since 2008. With +300 employees and +2,500 tons monthly capacity, we're ready to enter any market worldwide.
timeline_2018_factory: Modern factory opened in Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh
vision_text: To be the leading fish exporter from Egypt to the world, trusted by distributors, restaurants, and hotels for quality, reliability, and 24/7 availability.
mission_text: Delivering the finest Egyptian fresh fish to B2B buyers worldwide with ISO & HACCP certified quality, complete cold chain integrity, and flexible shipping via air or land.
values_subtitle: The principles that make us a trusted global fish supplier
value_trust_desc: 17+ years building partnerships with distributors and restaurant chains worldwide
value_quality_desc: ISO 22000, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 & HACCP certified operations
value_team_desc: +300 employees specialized in international fish export
value_leadership_desc: Egypt's largest fish exporter with +2,500 tons monthly capacity
factory_desc: EU-approved facility in Kafr El Sheikh
success_story_p2: Over 17 years, we've become the trusted fish supplier for 500+ distributors, restaurants, and hotels. We export worldwide via air and land - ready to enter your market.
success_story_p3: Our modern factory in Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh operates 24/7 with ISO & HACCP certification, ensuring consistent quality for B2B partners anywhere in the world.
cta_subtitle: Contact us for wholesale fish supply - we export to any destination worldwide
